title: Only what matters.
text: Why should proving one qualification mean revealing your entire identity? With Veil Pass, it does not. Prove what qualifies you. Reveal nothing else.

title: Private credentials. Practical verification.
text: Veil Pass is a privacy-preserving credential protocol built on Midnight. Organizations issue signed qualifications. Individuals prove eligibility without sharing the entire credential.

title: The issuer attests. You hold the key.
text: A developer creates a private credential wallet, with signing keys generated on their device. An authorized issuer approves enrollment and signs a qualification bound to that holder. The holder saves it in an encrypted vault, with an encrypted recovery backup. Here is our genuine hosted issuance flow.

title: One requirement. One private answer.
text: A hackathon needs evidence of approved training. Veil Pass binds its request to a specific application and policy. The hosted interface shows local credential checks. Separately, our terminal operator completed a real Midnight Preprod proof and confirmed authorization. The verifier receives the result, without needing the full credential.

title: Same qualification. A different policy.
text: The same test credential also meets a professional community's higher qualification requirement. A separate challenge produces a second confirmed Preprod authorization. One qualification, multiple policies, without another certificate upload. Wallet activity and timing remain observable.

title: Real code. Confirmed on Midnight.
text: Compact enforces issuer authenticity, holder authorization, private eligibility, active status and replay protection. Our V3 contract and both policy authorizations are confirmed on Midnight Preprod. This recorded execution used a dedicated terminal operator.

title: Valid once. Revocable when needed.
text: Reusing a consumed challenge is rejected. The authorized issuer can revoke a qualification, then publish the changed status to Midnight. After restoring the encrypted holder backup, a fresh authorization fails the active-membership constraint. The invalid request is rejected before any blockchain transaction is submitted.

title: Private by design. Verifiable on Midnight.
text: Veil Pass connects signed issuance, private eligibility proofs, reusable verification and enforceable revocation. Ninety-one root tests and thirty-nine signed-module tests passed. We have real Preprod execution and a developer verifier integration. Public-browser proofs, installed-wallet acceptance, institutional onboarding, independent review and an external pilot remain next. Explore the live website and inspect the evidence. Veil Pass. Prove what qualifies you. Reveal nothing else.
